description: A small evolving library repo: six sequential sessions in the SAME working tree, the way a real user works on a real project (new spec, new spec, new spec, regression, new spec, new spec). Fixture for the v3 project-continuity memory benchmark (runner-v3.mjs).

tasks.title: Implement calc.add
tasks.promptSpec: Create `calc.mjs` exporting `add(a, b)` that returns the integer sum of its two arguments. Keep the module tiny — no extra exports.

tasks.title: Implement stats.mean (uses calc.add)
tasks.promptSpec: Create `stats.mjs` exporting `mean(values)` that returns the arithmetic mean of a non-empty array of numbers. Implement it in terms of `add` imported from `./calc.mjs` (accumulate the sum with add). `mean([])` must throw a RangeError.

tasks.title: Implement format.formatReport
tasks.promptSpec: Create `format.mjs` exporting `formatReport(rows)` where rows is an array of `{ label, value }` objects. It returns a single string joining each row as `label: value` separated by ` | ` (space, pipe, space). An empty array returns the empty string.

tasks.title: Fix a seeded regression in calc.mjs
tasks.promptSpec: A regression slipped into the repo: the calc tests are failing. Find the root cause in the existing source and fix it. Do not modify any test file.

tasks.title: Implement persist (save/load JSON records)
tasks.promptSpec: Create `persist.mjs` exporting `save(path, records)` and `load(path)`. `save` writes `JSON.stringify(records)` followed by a single newline to `path` (UTF-8). `load` reads the file and returns the parsed array. Round-trip must preserve deep-equal records.

tasks.title: Implement search over records
tasks.promptSpec: Create `search.mjs` exporting `search(records, q)` returning the subset of record objects whose JSON serialization contains the query case-insensitively. Preserve input order; never mutate the input array.
